title: The Latest: The Week Ahead in the Impeachment Hearings

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无保留、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: It started with a whistleblower's complaint about President Trump's contact with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一名举报人对特朗普总统与外国领导人接触的投诉。

sentences.en: I had a perfect phone call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我和乌克兰总统进行了一次完美的通话。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, perfect.
sentences.zh: 我是说，非常完美。

sentences.en: Today, I'm announcing the House of Representatives moving forward with an official impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 今天，我宣布众议院将推进正式的弹劾调查。

sentences.en: Drama expected on Capitol Hill this week with the most crucial testimony yet.
sentences.zh: 本周国会山预计将上演一场大戏，届时将有最关键的证词出现。

sentences.en: At least eight witnesses are scheduled to testify this week in public hearings.
sentences.zh: 本周至少有八名证人定于在公开听证会上作证。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Julie Davis.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是朱莉·戴维斯。

sentences.en: It's week two of the impeachment inquiry, and we're preparing for tomorrow's hearings when we're going to hear from four witnesses all on the same day.
sentences.zh: 现在是弹劾调查的第二周，我们正在为明天的听证会做准备，届时我们将会在同一天听到四位证人的证词。

sentences.en: And Nick Fandos, our congressional reporter, is going to be there.
sentences.zh: 我们的国会记者尼克·凡多斯也会在那里。

sentences.en: He's on Capitol Hill right now preparing to take in all this new testimony and try to digest it and figure out where we are.
sentences.zh: 他现在就在国会山，准备记录所有这些新的证词，并试图消化和理清我们目前的处境。

sentences.en: So I'm going to give him a call and see what he's thinking about what we can expect.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算给他打个电话，看看他对我们能期待什么有什么看法。

sentences.en: House Daily Press.
sentences.zh: 众议院每日新闻处。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Can I talk to Nick Fandos, please?
sentences.zh: 请问能让我和尼克·凡多斯通话吗？

sentences.en: One moment.
sentences.zh: 请稍等。

sentences.en: Let me see where he is.
sentences.zh: 我看看他在哪儿。

sentences.en: There's usually good hold music, let's say.
sentences.zh: 通常这里的等待音乐还不错，我是说。

sentences.en: One moment.
sentences.zh: 请稍等。

sentences.en: This is Nick.
sentences.zh: 我是尼克。

sentences.en: Hey, Nick.
sentences.zh: 嘿，尼克。

sentences.en: It's Julie.
sentences.zh: 我是朱莉。

sentences.en: Hey, Julie.
sentences.zh: 嘿，朱莉。

sentences.en: So let's talk about how tomorrow's going to go.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈明天的情况吧。

sentences.en: Why do we have four witnesses?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们要安排四位证人？

sentences.en: Last week, on the first day, there were two, Bill Taylor and George Kent.
sentences.zh: 上周第一天只有两位，比尔·泰勒和乔治·肯特。

sentences.en: And Taylor really was the standout witness.
sentences.zh: 泰勒确实是表现最突出的证人。

sentences.en: He was the one who attracted all the attention.
sentences.zh: 他是吸引了所有人关注的那一位。

sentences.en: George Kent sort of got lost in the shuffle.
sentences.zh: 乔治·肯特在某种程度上被淹没了。

sentences.en: And then on the second day, Marie Yovanovitch was by herself.
sentences.zh: 然后在第二天，玛丽·约万诺维奇是一个人作证。

sentences.en: You know, it was just her on the panel.
sentences.zh: 你知道，小组里只有她一个人。

sentences.en: And that seemed to really open up a lot of room for Democrats to draw out her story in a compelling way.
sentences.zh: 这似乎确实为民主党人打开了很大的空间，让他们能够以引人入胜的方式引出她的故事。

sentences.en: And so I'm just kind of wondering, why call four people on the same day?
sentences.zh: 所以我有点好奇，为什么要安排四个人在同一天作证？

sentences.en: So I think that there's a couple of reasons.
sentences.zh: 我想有几个原因。

sentences.en: The main one being that Democrats just feel like they're in a time crunch.
sentences.zh: 最主要的原因是民主党人觉得他们时间紧迫。

sentences.en: The House is out for Thanksgiving next week.
sentences.zh: 众议院下周因感恩节休会。

sentences.en: And I think they want to move through a lot of these people quickly.
sentences.zh: 我想他们想尽快处理完这些人。

sentences.en: The other thing is that tomorrow there's technically two hearings, one in the morning and one in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，明天实际上有两场听证会，一场在上午，一场在下午。

sentences.en: And the afternoon is just two witnesses that the Republicans have requested.
sentences.zh: 下午只有两名共和党要求的证人。

sentences.en: And they're pretty ticked off, frankly, that those witnesses got shoved in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，他们对这些证人被挤到下午感到非常恼火。

sentences.en: That's when typically attendance is pretty poor for congressional hearings.
sentences.zh: 通常那个时候国会听证会的出席率很低。

sentences.en: People aren't going to be tuning in so much.
sentences.zh: 人们不会那么关注。

sentences.en: So they're accusing Democrats of trying to bury those witnesses.
sentences.zh: 所以他们指责民主党人试图掩盖这些证人的证词。

sentences.en: That happened to them last week with their questioning, right?
sentences.zh: 他们上周的质询也遇到了这种情况，对吧？

sentences.en: Like they didn't get to do the questioning until the afternoon when the viewership was way down.
sentences.zh: 比如他们直到下午收视率大幅下降时才得以进行质询。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And I think it may go into the evening this time.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这次可能会持续到晚上。

sentences.en: It'll be even worse.
sentences.zh: 那会更糟。

sentences.en: So who are these four people testifying tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 那么明天作证的这四个人是谁？

sentences.en: How's that going to work?
sentences.zh: 这会怎么进行？

sentences.en: It's Lieutenant Colonel Alexander Vindman, who's the top Ukraine expert at the White House
sentences.zh: 是亚历山大·温德曼中校，他是白宫负责乌克兰事务的顶级专家，

sentences.en: and was very alarmed by a phone call that he overheard between President Trump and the Ukrainian president.
sentences.zh: 他对无意中听到的特朗普总统与乌克兰总统之间的通话感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: Another witness worked for Mike Pence, the vice president.
sentences.zh: 另一位证人曾为副总统迈克·彭斯工作。

sentences.en: She also listened in on the call.
sentences.zh: 她也旁听了那次通话。

sentences.en: She didn't think it was great and testified that she thought it was improper, but did not raise her concerns in the same way Vindman did.
sentences.zh: 她认为那次通话并不好，并作证说她认为那是不恰当的，但她并没有像温德曼那样提出担忧。

sentences.en: And then in the afternoon, you've got Vindman's boss, Morrison, on the National Security Council at the White House and Kurt Volker,
sentences.zh: 然后在下午，你有温德曼的上司、白宫国家安全委员会的莫里森，以及库尔特·沃尔克，

sentences.en: who was the special envoy to Ukraine and was one of the so-called three amigos who were like deputized by President Trump to run Ukraine policy.
sentences.zh: 他曾是乌克兰问题特别代表，是所谓的“三个火枪手”之一，他们就像是被特朗普总统授权负责乌克兰政策的人。

sentences.en: Last week, we really heard about kind of the context in which this call happened.
sentences.zh: 上周，我们确实听到了关于这次通话背景的情况。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: career diplomats who talked about how they felt pushed aside by Rudy Giuliani and Gordon Sondland and to some degree Volker himself in a way that allowed this call to happen.
sentences.zh: 职业外交官们谈到了他们如何感到被鲁迪·朱利安尼和戈登·桑德兰，以及在某种程度上被沃尔克本人排挤，以至于让这次通话得以发生。

sentences.en: Vindman, what's interesting to me about tomorrow is it seems like we're sort of circling back to the July 25th call,
sentences.zh: 温德曼，明天让我感兴趣的是，我们似乎又回到了7月25日的通话，

sentences.en: the thing that started this whole saga, the thing that touched off the whistleblower complaint.
sentences.zh: 那件事开启了整个传奇，那件事引发了举报人的投诉。

sentences.en: You have people who listened in in real time to President Trump and the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 你有实时旁听特朗普总统和乌克兰总统通话的人。

sentences.en: Three out of the four, I think, right, were on that call.
sentences.zh: 我想四个人中有三个都在那次通话中，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So I think we're going to hear really different impressions of that phone call.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们会听到对那次通话非常不同的印象。

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: Vindman was really alarmed by it and went and raised his concerns immediately with White House lawyers and that at least fits the frame of a cover-up that the White House immediately tried to move to lock down this transcript because they knew it was problematic.
sentences.zh: 温德曼对此感到非常震惊，并立即向白宫律师提出了他的担忧，这至少符合掩盖事实的框架，即白宫立即试图封锁这份记录，因为他们知道这有问题。

sentences.en: Morrison, on the other hand, is going to talk about how he didn't see anything improper with the call and did suggest that it ought to be locked down,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，莫里森会谈到他认为通话中没有任何不当之处，并确实建议应该将其封锁，

sentences.en: but only because he thought it might be in this polarized environment, might be politically unflattering to the president.
sentences.zh: 但那只是因为他认为在这种两极分化的环境中，这可能会让总统在政治上显得难堪。

sentences.en: So we're going to hear a lot about what the White House was thinking during this consequential call that we'll both kind of push against the president's characterization that it was perfect
sentences.zh: 所以我们将听到很多关于白宫在这次重要通话期间的想法，这既会反驳总统关于通话“完美”的描述，

sentences.en: and then also maybe lend a little bit of authority behind that claim.
sentences.zh: 也可能会为这一说法增加一点权威性。

sentences.en: So who is the single witness you're most eager to hear from and, like, what do we want to hear from them?
sentences.zh: 那么你最想听哪位证人的证词，我们想从他们那里听到什么？

sentences.en: Kurt Volker.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·沃尔克。

sentences.en: He was the first witness who did a private interview with lawmakers more than a month ago now
sentences.zh: 他是第一个在超过一个月前与立法者进行私下采访的证人，

sentences.en: and basically at the time told them a lot of details that themselves were not flattering for the president
sentences.zh: 当时他基本上告诉了他们很多细节，这些细节本身对总统来说并不光彩，

sentences.en: that have helped them assemble their story, but his own conclusion was that there had not been a quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 这些细节帮助他们拼凑出了故事，但他自己的结论是并没有发生“利益交换”。

sentences.en: And so, you know, a lot of water has flowed under the bridge since he testified.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，自从他作证以来，已经发生了很多事情。

sentences.en: A lot of other witnesses have come forward that have made him look either, like, willfully ignorant, dense, like he may have been misleading the committee.
sentences.zh: 很多其他证人站了出来，让他们看起来要么是故意无知、愚钝，要么是他可能一直在误导委员会。

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: So I'm really curious, does his testimony evolve at all?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，他的证词会有所改变吗？

sentences.en: And if so, that could be a big blow to the president and his defense because they've really leaned on him.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，那对总统及其辩护团队来说可能是一个沉重的打击，因为他们确实很依赖他。

sentences.en: Or does he stick to his guns and say, I was deeply involved in all of this.
sentences.zh: 或者他会坚持自己的立场，说：“我深度参与了这一切。”

sentences.en: I worked closely with Gordon Sondland.
sentences.zh: “我与戈登·桑德兰密切合作。”

sentences.en: I spoke with Rudy Giuliani.
sentences.zh: “我与鲁迪·朱利安尼谈过。”

sentences.en: I spoke with the president.
sentences.zh: “我与总统谈过。”

sentences.en: And I don't think that there was, in the end, any quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: “而且我认为最终并没有任何利益交换。”

sentences.en: And in that case, I think the Republicans will be pretty pleased with him.
sentences.zh: 如果是那样的话，我想共和党人会对他非常满意。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Well, thanks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢。

sentences.en: Talk soon.
sentences.zh: 回头聊。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thanks, Julie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，朱莉。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I should also mention that the other big story today that relates to all of this is that we learned that lawmakers in the impeachment inquiry are actually investigating
sentences.zh: 我还应该提到，今天与这一切相关的另一个大新闻是，我们得知弹劾调查中的立法者实际上正在调查

sentences.en: whether President Trump lied in the written answers he gave during the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在穆勒调查期间提供的书面回答中是否撒了谎。

sentences.en: So House impeachment investigators are looking at this question officially now.
sentences.zh: 所以众议院弹劾调查人员现在正在正式调查这个问题。

sentences.en: And the reason that that's interesting is because there have been a lot of questions and there's been a lot of debate internally among House Democrats about whether they even
sentences.zh: 之所以这很有趣，是因为众议院民主党内部一直有很多疑问和争论，关于他们是否甚至

sentences.en: want to go there and deal at all with the Mueller investigation when they get to drafting articles of impeachment about this Ukraine affair.
sentences.zh: 想在起草关于乌克兰事件的弹劾条款时，去触及和处理穆勒调查的问题。

sentences.en: There had been a thought early on that they should stay focused just on Ukraine, just on this clear allegation that they're looking at right now about whether the president abused
sentences.zh: 早先有一种想法是，他们应该只关注乌克兰，只关注他们现在正在调查的关于总统是否滥用

sentences.en: his power.
sentences.zh: 权力的明确指控。

sentences.en: But now this brings back this question of whether the president's conduct and in this case, whether
sentences.zh: 但现在这又引出了一个问题，即总统的行为，在这种情况下，即

sentences.en: the president's actual truthfulness in the Mueller investigation is going to be an issue for impeachment articles in the House.
sentences.zh: 总统在穆勒调查中的真实性，是否会成为众议院弹劾条款的一个议题。

sentences.en: And that's an open question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: And we still don't know the answer yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道答案。

sentences.en: So we're following that, too.
sentences.zh: 所以我们也在关注这一点。

sentences.en: So that's the lateSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是最新的消息。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和萨拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《Metro》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你收听播客的地方收听。
